_comment: 相談の 練習の「話しかける タイミング」（要望 #723）。shirai の 席の 絵 4枚: 大丈夫そう（しごとは して いる）・電話中・いそがしそう（あせって いる）・ほかの 人と 話して いる。1枚目（大丈夫そう）が 絵柄アンカーに なり、残り 3枚は 机・小物・構図を そろえて 動きと 表情だけ 変える。looks は 立ち絵の 台帳から 逐語。背景ごと 撮る（切りぬかない）。 2026-11-13: tomy さんの 指定「白井さんのシャツにネクマックスを入れて」（要望 #742）で、トレーナーの 左胸に ネクマックスの 絵を 入れて 作り直した（参考 scripts/images/refs/nexmax_shirt_print.png）。
style: Style: clean modern Japanese manga / anime style, soft cel shading, bright friendly palette, rounded shapes, no harsh shadows, warm daylight, contemporary Japan, kid-safe e-learning illustration. EMOTIONS ARE BIG AND OBVIOUS, like a Japanese comedy manga.
noText: No text, no letters, no kanji, no kana, no numbers anywhere in the image: computer screens show only abstract coloured blocks and lines, papers and sticky notes are blank. No watermark, no signature, no logo, no frame border.
negative: Never: realistic photo rendering, harsh gradients, six fingers, extra limbs, readable letters, dark horror tone, angry faces, real sadness or tears, costume changes between the four pictures, a drawn checkerboard pattern, a second copy of the main character.

scenes.title: 大丈夫そう（しごとは して いる）
scenes.scene:
Character: デザイナー（Webデザインを 担当） — Japanese-style anime character, man in his mid thirties, medium build, relaxed cheerful posture. His face, hair and glasses are taken from the reference photograph — keep the same face shape, eyes and smile, drawn in anime style. Short black hair kept neat and low: the sides and back are cut short, the top is only slightly longer and lightly brushed up and back at the front with a little texture. The hair stays close to the head — NOT spiky, NOT fluffy or voluminous, NOT messy. Round dark-brown tortoiseshell glasses with thin rims (boston shape). Fair skin, dark brown eyes that crinkle when he smiles, a wide bright smile showing his upper teeth, clean-shaven. Outfit: off-white crew-neck sweatshirt (#F3F1EA) with long sleeves and ribbed cuffs, with ONE small printed illustration of the NexMax robot mascot on the left chest (copy it from the mascot reference picture: a light-blue round-headed robot with a white face, two black eyes and a small orange mouth, pointing up with one hand), about the size of a palm, the same print in every picture; no letters or words on the sweatshirt; beige chino trousers (#CDBB9A); white low-top sneakers. Carries a slim silver tablet and a white stylus pen (he draws on it). No lanyard.
Setting: the bright small software team office in Japan from the office reference picture (morning light from the windows on the left, whiteboard, potted plants). He sits on an office chair at his own desk. On the desk: a laptop and one external monitor, his slim silver tablet with a white stylus pen, a coffee mug. Camera: eye level, from slightly front-left, a medium shot showing him from the waist up and the whole desk top; he is in the centre of the picture with some office visible around him. This first picture sets the desk, props and framing for the next three pictures.
State: calmly working — it would be fine to talk to him now. He types on the laptop at an easy pace, shoulders relaxed, sitting upright, a calm focused face with a small gentle smile, looking at the screen. The desk is tidy. He is clearly working, but not in a hurry. The expression and body language must read clearly at a glance even when the picture is small.
